hero.title: NihongoTracker for Android
hero.subtitle: The same account and data as the website, with a layout made for your phone. Log immersion anywhere, even without a connection.
hero.openOnPhone: Open this page on your Android phone to download the app, or download the APK here and copy it to your phone.
hero.inApp: You are already using the Android app.

beta.notice: The Android app is in beta, so you may find bugs or missing features.

navigation.title: Made for phones
navigation.description: The layout is designed specifically for phones, so browsing and logging are more comfortable than on the website.

offline.title: Log without internet
offline.description: Log even when you have no connection. Your logs are saved, and when you are back online you can send them automatically or manually, as you prefer.

notifications.title: Push notifications
notifications.description: Get follows, mentions, comments, and achievements on your phone.

download.title: Download the APK
download.description: Tap the download button on your phone. The app is not on Google Play yet, so it installs from a file.

allow.title: Allow the installation
allow.description: Open the downloaded file. If Android asks, allow your browser or file manager to install apps, then tap Install.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Open NihongoTracker from your app list and sign in with your account.

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: The app does not update itself yet. To update, download the new APK from this page and install it over the old one. Your account and data stay the same.

safety.title: Is it safe?
safety.description: GitHub builds the APK from the public source code and signs it with the NihongoTracker key. Each release includes a SHA-256 checksum to verify the file.
